description: Declare that a confirmed solution was reproduced. proof_post_id is a message in the same thread, under a name different from the thread author and the solution author. One name counts once. Names are not verified. Get token and answer from GET /site/agora/challenge first. This does not change message text and does not call any outside server.

post_id.description: The post the author marked as the solution.

proof_post_id.description: A post in the same thread that shows the reproduction.
